item.title: Cross-border health scheme to benefit local residents
item.description: New research has revealed that over 76% of Cavan residents are unaware of the Northern Ireland Planned Healthcare Scheme (NIPHS). The research was commissioned by Kingsbridge Private Hospital. The cross-border scheme allows patients living in the Republic of Ireland to receive medical treatment in Northern Ireland and claim 100% reimbursement from the HSE for approved surgeries. item.title: Appeal issued over missing Cavan teen
item.description: Gardaí are seeking the public’s assistance in tracing the whereabouts of Lucy Cawley (15) who was reported missing from Arva, Co Cavan, since Tuesday 27th January 2026. Lucy is described as being approximately 5 foot 4 inches in height, of slim build with blonde hair and blue eyes. Gardaí are concerned for Lucy’s well-being. item.description: Gardaí are appealing for information following a number of burglaries which were reported in the Cavan Town area. According to Gardaí, all burglaries took place on the same date. A burglary took place in Glenlara between the hours of 7pm and 8:30pm. Advertisement A private dwelling was forcibly entered through the rear door and a room in the house was ransacked. item.title: Search for permanent special school site 'can get underway'
item.description: A local Senator has raised concerns that the special school in Monaghan is an "interim" facility. Speaking in the Seanad this week, Senator Robbie Gallagher said that the Department of Education must "not lose track" of the need for a permanent special school. The Minister for Education, Hildegarde Naughton told the senator that she is engaging with officials about the provision of future special schools and special classes right across the country, including in Monaghan. item.title: County Cavan church celebrates bicentenary
item.description: A church in Co Cavan is celebrating a special milestone this weekend. This Sunday marks the bicentenary of St. Brigid's Church in Drumhurt, Kill. The current church was built in 1826 and has been a central part of parish life, hosting baptisms, weddings, funerals, and daily prayer for generations. Advertisement This Sunday promises to be a big community event, marking the importance of the church to the local people. item.title: 5 appear in court in relation to Monaghan public order incident
item.description: Five men have appeared before Monaghan Circuit Court today in relation to a violent disorder that took place in Monaghan Town. The incident that involved at least 10 men occurred outside McConnon’s Londis in Monaghan Town on April of 2024. All five appeared this afternoon at Monaghan Circuit Court in relation to this incident that lasted for 2 minutes at Old Cross Square almost two years ago. item.title: Emergency services at serious road collision in Co Monaghan
item.description: The Monaghan Road in Roslea is currently closed following a serious road traffic collision. The collision occurred near Inishammon Cross Road, Smithboro in County Monaghan.
